A '''scavenger camp''' was located in the [[Glacial Fissure]] region on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where scavengers used equipment to melt ice. The camp was overrun by the [[White Maw]] pirates and the equipment was stolen.<ref name="TOR" />
